bibliography.title: Learning Unmasking Policies for Diffusion Language Models

sections.title: 3.1 dLLM Sampling as a Markov Decision Process
4.4 Exploring the Design Space of πϕ

module_metrics.description: 本文的 MDP、ELBO、GRPO 与 reward 公式承担方法定义与机制解释；逐页核对未见 theorem、lemma、proposition、corollary、proof 或可证明保证，因此 theory 语义模块不适用。

abstract_sentences.text: Diffusion (Large) Language Models (dLLMs) now match the downstream performance of their autoregressive counterparts on many tasks, while holding the promise of being more efficient during inference.
One critical design aspect of dLLMs is the sampling procedure that selects which tokens to unmask at each diffusion step.

evidence.anchor: sampling procedure selects tokens to unmask

abstract_sentences.text: Indeed, recent work has found that heuristic strategies such as confidence thresholding improve both sample quality and token throughput compared to random unmasking.

evidence.anchor: improve sample quality and token throughput

abstract_sentences.text: However, such heuristics have downsides: they require manual tuning, and we observe that their performance degrades with larger block sizes.

evidence.anchor: performance degrades with larger block sizes

abstract_sentences.text: In this work, we instead propose to train sampling procedures using reinforcement learning.

evidence.anchor: train sampling procedures using reinforcement learning

abstract_sentences.text: Specifically, we formalize masked diffusion sampling as a Markov decision process in which the dLLM serves as the environment, and propose a lightweight policy based on a single-layer transformer that maps dLLM token confidences to unmasking decisions.

Our experiments show that these trained policies match the performance of state-of-the-art heuristics when combined with semi-autoregressive (block) generation, while outperforming them in the full-diffusion setting.

evidence.anchor: outperforming them in the full-diffusion setting

claim_closure.claim: 训练与 policy design insights 可解释 performance。

claim_closure.evidence_response: Figures 5、9、20、22–26 形成干预或描述性证据。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: 结论称给出 quantitative and qualitative insight。

claim_closure.claim: learned policy 的 unmasking behavior 与 confidence heuristic 定性不同。

claim_closure.evidence_response: N=100 GSM8K samples 的 rank correlation、adjacency 与 token grids。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: 结论没有额外新增该主张。

claim_closure.claim: 方法可自动发现 scalable and robust sampling mechanisms。
claim_closure.method_response: 方法机制提供一种自动优化 route。
claim_closure.evidence_response: 实验范围限于两类 7–8B dLLM 和少数 tasks，且 domain transfer 与 stability 有明确限制。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: 结论提出该影响，但后接每 α 单独训练与细粒度控制问题。

final_judgment.single_storyline: Confidence heuristics 在近似求解 adaptive sequential decision problem；冻结 dLLM 后以 lightweight RL policy 直接学习 unmask action，主要收益出现在 heuristic 脆弱的 full-diffusion regime。[pp. 2, 4–6, 8]
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留问题诊断、MDP、policy/reward、主 Pareto、transfer、design ablation 和限制；这些足以判断主张方向。[pp. 3–12]
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Appendix 转移精确数据、扩展 baseline、sensitivity、qualitative grids、DPLS/ES 细节、配置与架构。数值复核依赖 Appendix J，训练复现依赖 H。[pp. 17–39]
final_judgment.best_pattern: 用 Figure 1 建立 heuristic failure，以 MDP/Figure 2 给机制，再以同轴 Figure 4 比较 regimes，并用 Figure 9 与 Appendix C 处理替代解释。[pp. 3–11, 25–27]
final_judgment.largest_gap: scalable/robust 的结论覆盖范围超过两个 7–8B dLLM 与有限任务；coding transfer、α/ES instability 和 full-diffusion optimum 均留下直接边界。[pp. 7–10, 12–13]
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 对 adaptive-computation 主张，先形式化真正的 decision unit，再把 mechanism、matched Pareto、failure regime 和 alternative explanation ablation 写成一条证据链。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 此规则依赖可冻结的环境、可可靠观察的 rollout reward 和可承受的 policy state；base model 必须更新、语义状态不可压缩为 confidence、或 reward 不可靠时需重做设计与验证。
final_judgment.rhetoric: 主文的强动词集中在图表结果附近，qualitative mechanism 则用 likely、appears、one hypothesis 等限定词；这使经验事实与解释性推断大多可区分。[pp. 7–10, 25–27]
